engines: Tüm VAG Benzinli (TSI/TFSI) ve Dizel (TDI) Motorlar
commonCauses: Belt Assist Position Sensör Okuma Değerleri missing/faulty
stepByStepSolution:
Kontrol edin: /Değiştirin / Yenileyin:  Motor for Belt Assistant
Kontrol edin:  Belt Assistant Movement
Kontrol edin:  Measuring Value Blocks (MVB)
Gerçekleştirin: Output Test/Basic Setting
Kontrol edin:  Belt Assist Position Sensör Okuma Değerleri
technicalNotes: The Belt Assist is the Feature which pushes the Driver/Passenger Belt forward once you open the Door to help the Driver/Passenger reaching for the Seat Belt.
